# 14 — Repo hygiene: untrack internal tooling, logs, binary DB, stale lockfile

**Labels:** `chore`, `tech-debt`

## Problem
`git ls-files` shows ~1,076 files under `skills/` (internal z-ai agent tooling,
not part of the product), plus `dev.log` (104 KB of dev-server output),
`db/custom.db` (372 KB binary SQLite, regenerated by `bun run db:push`), and a
stale `package-lock.json` (the repo standardizes on bun + `bun.lock`).
This bloats clones, pollutes diffs, and risks leaking runtime details.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `git rm -r --cached skills/ dev.log db/custom.db package-lock.json`
      (files stay on disk for local dev, disappear from the repo)
- [ ] `.gitignore` gains: `skills/`, `dev.log`, `db/custom.db`,
      `package-lock.json` (with a comment each)
- [ ] `git ls-files | wc -l` drops by ~1,079
- [ ] `bun install` still resolves; `bun run build` unaffected
- [ ] Nothing under `src/` references `skills/`

## Notes
- Commit message: `chore(repo): untrack internal tooling, logs, binary db, stale lockfile (#14)`
